# sophosfirewall_ipv6_address (Resource)

Manages an IPv6 address object (*Objects > Hosts and services > IP host*). Set exactly one of `ip_address`, `network`, `range_start`/`range_end` or `ip_addresses`; switching between them recreates the object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv6_address" "corp_v6" {
  name    = "corp-v6"
  network = "2001:db8:10::/64"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_ipv6_address" "web_v6" {
  name       = "web-v6"
  ip_address = "2001:db8:10::10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the IPv6 address object.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `ip_address` (String) A single host address.
- `ip_addresses` (Set of String) A list of host addresses.
- `network` (String) A network in CIDR notation, e.g. `2001:db8::/64`.
- `range_end` (String) Last address of an address range. Requires `range_start`.
- `range_start` (String) First address of an address range. Requires `range_end`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_ipv6_address.example <name-or-uuid>
```
